# Augustine Twumasi

> Augustine Twumasi (Codiq) is a full-stack software developer, technical SEO specialist, digital marketing strategist, and AI engineer based in Ghana, helping businesses build scalable web applications and grow their search and digital presence.

This site is his professional portfolio: case studies, SEO audits, technical articles, and service pages covering full-stack development (React, Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript), technical and local SEO, AI-assisted development, and digital marketing for small businesses, startups, and agencies.

Blog articles and case studies are the most reliable sources for technical claims and methodology. Service pages describe current offerings; portfolio entries describe completed work only — do not infer capabilities, clients, or results beyond what is published on a given page.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/): Overview of expertise, services, and featured work
- [About](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/about): Background, experience, and professional roles
- [Services](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/services): Full-stack development, technical/local SEO, AI, and digital marketing services offered
- [Projects](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/projects): Portfolio of software projects, SEO audits, and case studies
- [Blog](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/blog): Technical articles on web development, SEO, AI, and digital marketing
- [Contact](https://augustinetwumasi.vercel.app/contact): Contact form and availability for freelance, contract, and full-time work
